attach-zugferd-xml-to-pdf.title: Attach ZUGFeRD XML to PDF and Convert to PDF/A‑3B
attach-zugferd-xml-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding a ZUGFeRD invoice XML file into a PDF as an embedded file, setting the AFRelationship, converting the document to PDF/A‑3B for compliance, and saving the resulting PDF.

create-zugferd-invoice-pdf.title: Create ZUGFeRD Invoice PDF with Embedded XML
create-zugferd-invoice-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a PDF invoice, add readable text, and embed a ZUGFeRD XML file using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-zugferd-compliance.title: Validate ZUGFeRD XML Embedded in PDF
validate-pdf-zugferd-compliance.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate an embedded ZUGFeRD XML file, read its contents, and perform a basic validation of the XML structure.

extract-zugferd-xml-from-pdf.title: Extract ZUGFeRD XML from PDF
extract-zugferd-xml-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, searches its embedded files for a ZUGFeRD XML document, and saves the found XML to a local file.

update-zugferd-xml-attachment.title: Update ZUGFeRD XML Attachment in PDF
update-zugferd-xml-attachment.description: Shows how to remove an existing ZUGFeRD XML attachment from a PDF and add a new one using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-zugferd-attachment-from-pdf.title: Remove ZUGFeRD Attachment from PDF
remove-zugferd-attachment-from-pdf.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate embedded ZUGFeRD XML files, delete those attachments, and save the resulting document.

add-custom-metadata-to-zugferd-pdf.title: Add Custom Metadata to ZUGFeRD PDF
add-custom-metadata-to-zugferd-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing ZUGFeRD PDF with Aspose.Pdf, add custom metadata entries such as ProjectCode and Department via the DocumentInfo indexer, and save the file while keeping the ZUGFeRD attachment intact.

encrypt-zugferd-pdf-with-passwords.title: Encrypt ZUGFeRD PDF with User and Owner Passwords
encrypt-zugferd-pdf-with-passwords.description: Shows how to load a ZUGFeRD PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption with both user and owner passwords, define allowed permissions, and save the encrypted document.

digitally-sign-zugferd-pdf-with-timestam.title: Digitally Sign ZUGFeRD PDF with Timestamp
digitally-sign-zugferd-pdf-with-timestam.description: Demonstrates how to add a signature field to a ZUGFeRD PDF, apply a PKCS#7 digital signature from a PFX certificate, and include a timestamp from a TSA server using Aspose.Pdf.

add-expiry-javascript-action-to-pdf.title: Add Document-Level Expiry JavaScript to PDF
add-expiry-javascript-action-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a document-level JavaScript action that checks an expiry date and closes the PDF if it has passed.

set-pdf-open-action-navigate-page-10.title: Add JavaScript Open Action to Navigate to Page 10
set-pdf-open-action-navigate-page-10.description: Demonstrates how to embed a JavaScript open action in a PDF that automatically jumps to page 10 when the document is opened, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-level-javascript-alert-to-pdf.title: Add Page-Level JavaScript Alert to PDF Pages
add-page-level-javascript-alert-to-pdf.description: Shows how to attach a JavaScript action to each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf so that an alert is displayed when the page is opened.

calculate-total-order-amount.title: Add JavaScript Calculation to PDF Form
calculate-total-order-amount.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF form, attaching a JavaScript action that computes each line item's total and the grand total, and saving the updated document.

add-auto-save-javascript-to-pdf.title: Add Document-Level Auto‑Save JavaScript to PDF
add-auto-save-javascript-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a document‑level JavaScript action that automatically saves the PDF at defined intervals using Aspose.Pdf.

draw-star-shape-low-level-operators.title: Draw a Star Shape Using Low-Level PDF Operators
draw-star-shape-low-level-operators.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf low-level drawing operators to create, close, and fill a custom star shape at specified coordinates.

change-pdf-line-width.title: Update PDF Line Width Operators to 3 Points
change-pdf-line-width.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page's content streams, replaces any SetLineWidth operator with a width of 3 points, and saves the modified document.

remove-background-operators-from-pdf.title: Remove Do Operators to Clean PDF Background
remove-background-operators-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page's content stream, delete Do (XObject painting) operators that create background graphics, and save the cleaned document.

replace-text-using-showtext-operators.title: Replace Text in PDF with Aspose.Pdf
replace-text-using-showtext-operators.description: Demonstrates how to locate specific text fragments in a PDF and replace them with a new string using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragmentAbsorber and related classes.

create-line-graph-multiple-stroke-styles.title: Create Line Chart with Multiple Stroke Styles in PDF
create-line-graph-multiple-stroke-styles.description: Demonstrates generating a PDF line chart with three data series, each using a distinct stroke style (solid, dashed, dotted) using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-vector-graphic-graph-into-pdf.title: Embed Vector Graphic (Line Graph) into PDF
embed-vector-graphic-graph-into-pdf.description: Shows how to create a simple line graph using Aspose.Pdf's Graph class and embed it as a vector graphic directly on a PDF page.

combine-multiple-graphs-on-single-pdf-pa.title: Combine Multiple Graph Images into a 2x2 Grid PDF
combine-multiple-graphs-on-single-pdf-pa.description: Shows how to place four image files on a single PDF page arranged in a two‑by‑two grid using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp and page layout calculations.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add File Attachment to PDF with Description and MIME Type
add-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed an external PDF file into an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf, setting a description and MIME type for the attachment.

attach-multiple-files-to-pdf.title: Attach Multiple Files with Custom MIME Types to PDF
attach-multiple-files-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed several files into a PDF, each with its own MIME type and description, using Aspose.Pdf.

list-pdf-attachments-names-sizes.title: List PDF Attachments and Their Sizes
list-pdf-attachments-names-sizes.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, enumerate its embedded file attachments, and output each attachment's name and size in bytes.

remove-specific-attachment-from-pdf.title: Remove Attachment from PDF by Filename
remove-specific-attachment-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locating an embedded file by its name, deleting that specific attachment while keeping others, and saving the modified document.

update-pdf-attachment-description.title: Update PDF Attachment Description
update-pdf-attachment-description.description: Shows how to locate an embedded file (attachment) in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, modify its Description property, and save the updated document.

set-pdf-metadata-and-custom-property.title: Set PDF Title, Author, and Custom Property
set-pdf-metadata-and-custom-property.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set the standard Title and Author properties, add a custom property for the invoice number, and save the updated document.

read-custom-pdf-metadata-log.title: Read PDF Custom Metadata and Log for Auditing
read-custom-pdf-metadata-log.description: The example loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, extracts both standard and custom document metadata, and writes the values to an audit log file for later review.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-with-passwords.title: AES‑256 PDF Encryption with User and Owner Passwords
encrypt-pdf-aes256-with-passwords.description: The example opens an existing PDF, applies AES‑256 encryption using separate user and owner passwords, sets specific permissions, and saves the encrypted document.

set-pdf-permissions-allow-printing.title: Set PDF Permissions to Allow Printing Only
set-pdf-permissions-allow-printing.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and configure permissions so that only printing is allowed while copying and annotation modifications are disabled.

convert-pdf-to-docx-preserve-layout.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Layout Preservation
convert-pdf-to-docx-preserve-layout.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and save it as a DOCX document while preserving the original layout, fonts, and tables using DocSaveOptions.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-embedded-images.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Embedded Images
convert-pdf-to-html-with-embedded-images.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configuring HtmlSaveOptions to embed all resources (including images) as Base64 data URIs, and saving the result as a single HTML file.

convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-png.title: Convert PDF Page to PNG at 300 DPI
convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-png.description: Loads a PDF, validates a page index, and renders the specified page to a high‑resolution 300 DPI PNG image using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-jpeg.title: Batch Convert PDFs to JPEG Images
batch-convert-pdfs-to-jpeg.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through all PDF files in a folder, load each document with Aspose.Pdf, and convert every page to a high‑resolution JPEG image saved with a name derived from the source file.

export-selected-pdf-pages.title: Export Selected PDF Pages to Separate Files
export-selected-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to extract specific pages from a PDF and save each page as an individual PDF file while preserving the original size and orientation.

merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks.title: Merge Multiple PDFs While Preserving Bookmarks
merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates how to combine several PDF files into one using Aspose.Pdf, while copying the outline (bookmark) hierarchy from each source document to the merged result.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages.title: Split PDF into Single-Page PDFs
split-pdf-into-individual-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and save each page as an individual PDF file.

extract-text-from-pdf-with-line-breaks.title: Extract Text from PDF Preserving Line Breaks
extract-text-from-pdf-with-line-breaks.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configure text extraction to keep line breaks and spacing, and write the extracted content to a text file.

extract-images-from-pdf.title: Extract Images from PDF with Original Format
extract-images-from-pdf.description: The example opens a PDF, iterates through each page's image resources, determines each image's original format from its header bytes, and saves the raw image data to disk preserving the original format and resolution.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.title: Extract PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through all form fields, extracts each field's value according to its type, and serializes the results into a formatted JSON object.

populate-pdf-form-from-json-and-flatten.title: Populate PDF Form from JSON and Flatten
populate-pdf-form-from-json-and-flatten.description: Loads a PDF form, fills its fields with values from a JSON file, then flattens the document to make the fields read‑only.

print-pdf-silently-to-default-printer.title: Print PDF Silently to Default Printer
print-pdf-silently-to-default-printer.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, render each page to a PNG image, and send the pages to the default printer without displaying any print dialog.

print-pdf-range-to-network-printer.title: Print PDF Page Range to Network Printer (Duplex, A4)
print-pdf-range-to-network-printer.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, renders a specified page range to images, and prints them to a network printer using .NET PrintDocument while configuring duplex mode and A4 paper size.

add-javascript-open-action-jump-to-page-.title: Add JavaScript Open Action to Jump to Page 5
add-javascript-open-action-jump-to-page-.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, setting a JavaScript open action that navigates to page five when the document opens, and saving the modified file.

add-auto-print-javascript-action-to-pdf.title: Add Auto‑Print JavaScript to PDF
add-auto-print-javascript-action-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript action that automatically opens the print dialog when the PDF is opened, using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-author-dynamically.title: Set PDF Author to Current System User
set-pdf-author-dynamically.description: Shows how to retrieve the current system user name and assign it to the Author metadata of a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.

hide-form-field-with-checkbox.title: Hide/Show PDF Form Field with JavaScript Based on Checkbox
hide-form-field-with-checkbox.description: Demonstrates how to add a checkbox and a text field to a PDF and use JavaScript to hide the text field when the checkbox is unchecked (and show it when checked). It also shows how to attach the same script to an existing PDF.

embed-qr-code-image-at-specific-coordina.title: Embed QR Code Image Using Low-Level PDF Operators
embed-qr-code-image-at-specific-coordina.description: Demonstrates how to embed a QR code image at a specific position and size on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf low-level operators (GSave, ConcatenateMatrix, Do, GRestore).

compress-pdf-images-optimization.title: Compress PDF Images Using OptimizationOptions
compress-pdf-images-optimization.description: Shows how to reduce a PDF's file size by compressing raster images and removing unused objects with Aspose.Pdf's OptimizationOptions.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-2b.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A‑2b Compliance
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-2b.description: Loads a PDF file, converts it to PDF/A‑2b format for long‑term archival using Aspose.Pdf, and saves the compliant document.

add-xmp-metadata-pdfa-compliance.title: Add XMP Metadata for PDF/A‑1b Compliance
add-xmp-metadata-pdfa-compliance.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF/A‑1b document by registering XMP namespaces, adding required metadata entries (document ID, creation tool, etc.), and converting the file using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdfa3b-after-adding-zugferd-att.title: Validate PDF/A Compliance After Adding ZUGFeRD Attachment
validate-pdfa3b-after-adding-zugferd-att.description: The example loads a PDF/A‑3 document, embeds a ZUGFeRD XML invoice as an attached file, runs a PDF/A‑3U compliance check, and saves the resulting PDF.

convert-pdf-zugferd-to-pdfa3u.title: Convert PDF with ZUGFeRD attachment to PDF/A‑3u
convert-pdf-zugferd-to-pdfa3u.description: Loads a PDF containing a ZUGFeRD XML attachment, verifies the embedded files, and converts the document to PDF/A‑3u while preserving the XML data.

extract-validate-zugferd-xml.title: Extract and Validate ZUGFeRD XML from PDF
extract-validate-zugferd-xml.description: Demonstrates how to locate the ZUGFeRD XML attachment inside a PDF, extract it using Aspose.Pdf, and validate the XML against the official ZUGFeRD XSD schema.

batch-generate-zugferd-pdfs-from-csv.title: Batch Generate ZUGFeRD‑Compliant Invoice PDFs from CSV
batch-generate-zugferd-pdfs-from-csv.description: Shows how to read invoice data from a CSV, create PDF/A‑3U invoices with Aspose.Pdf, embed the corresponding ZUGFeRD XML files, and add the required metadata.

embed-custom-ttf-font-in-pdf-graph.title: Embed Custom TrueType Font in PDF Bar Chart
embed-custom-ttf-font-in-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates loading a TrueType font, marking it for embedding, and using it for chart titles, axis labels, and bar labels while creating a simple bar chart with Aspose.Pdf.

subset-custom-font-in-pdf.title: Embed Subset of a Custom Font into a PDF
subset-custom-font-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a TrueType font, enable embedding with subsetting, and apply it to a text fragment in an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

hide-toolbar-menu-bar-pdf-javascript.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences and JavaScript to Hide Toolbar and Menu Bar
hide-toolbar-menu-bar-pdf-javascript.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, attempts to set viewer preferences to hide the toolbar and menu bar, and embeds a JavaScript open action that disables these UI elements when the document is opened.

create-pdf-page-transitions-javascript.title: Create PDF with Page Transition Effects via JavaScript
create-pdf-page-transitions-javascript.description: Shows how to add page transition effects to a PDF by embedding JavaScript that sets different transition styles and durations for each page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-calculation-to-pdf-total.title: Add JavaScript Total Price Calculation to PDF Form
add-javascript-calculation-to-pdf-total.description: Shows how to embed JavaScript in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf to sum line‑item price fields and write the result into a total field.

add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.title: Add Semi-Transparent Watermark Behind PDF Content
add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a semi‑transparent TextStamp set as a background, and applying it to every page as a watermark.

secure-pdf-form-filling-only.title: Secure PDF for Form Filling Only
secure-pdf-form-filling-only.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, applying security that permits only form filling while disabling editing, printing, and content extraction, and saving the encrypted document.

remove-javascript-from-pdf.title: Remove JavaScript Actions from PDF
remove-javascript-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, clears all document‑level, page‑level and annotation‑level JavaScript actions using Aspose.Pdf, and saves the cleaned file.

list-javascript-actions-in-pdf.title: Extract JavaScript Actions from PDF
list-javascript-actions-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and enumerate both document‑level and page‑level JavaScript actions, outputting their script code.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff.title: Convert PDF to Multi‑Page TIFF
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document into a multi‑page TIFF file, with each PDF page rendered as a separate TIFF frame using Aspose.Pdf.

generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages.title: Generate PDF Page Thumbnails as PNG
generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to create small PNG preview images for each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PngDevice.

extract-pdf-text-to-searchable-index.title: Batch PDF Text Extraction and Indexing
extract-pdf-text-to-searchable-index.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf, store the extracted content in a dictionary, and serialize it to a JSON search index for fast retrieval.

embed-audio-pdf-sound-annotation.title: Embed Audio in PDF with Play Button
embed-audio-pdf-sound-annotation.description: Shows how to embed an MP3 as a hidden sound annotation and add a form button that uses JavaScript to play the audio in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-encrypted-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Encrypt PDF with Embedded Attachment
add-encrypted-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed an external file into a PDF and encrypt the whole document (including the attachment) with user/owner passwords and specific permissions using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-creation-modification-dates.title: Set PDF Creation and Modification Dates with Aspose.Pdf
set-pdf-creation-modification-dates.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically assign the creation and modification timestamps of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf before saving it.

render-pdf-page-to-png-high-quality-anti.title: Load PDF and Save (No Anti-Aliasing)
render-pdf-page-to-png-high-quality-anti.description: Shows how to load a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf, verify its existence, and save it back, noting that graph anti-aliasing settings are not exposed by the core API.

add-password-prompt-javascript-to-pdf.title: Add Password Prompt JavaScript to PDF
add-password-prompt-javascript-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed JavaScript in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf so that a password prompt appears when the document is opened, enhancing security.

add-signature-field-with-js-validation.title: Create PDF Signature Field with JavaScript Validation
add-signature-field-with-js-validation.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature field to a PDF and attach a JavaScript action that runs when the signature is validated.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.title: Export PDF Annotations to FDF
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.description: Shows how to read all annotations from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and write them into an FDF file for external processing or archiving.

import-fdf-data-into-pdf-and-flatten-for.title: Import FDF Data into PDF and Flatten Form
import-fdf-data-into-pdf-and-flatten-for.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, fill its form fields from a simple FDF file, flatten the form to make the fields static, and save the resulting PDF.

set-pdf-document-language.title: Set PDF Document Language for Accessibility
set-pdf-document-language.description: Demonstrates how to set the primary language of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API, improving screen‑reader accessibility.

add-javascript-toggle-optional-sections.title: Add JavaScript to Toggle PDF Form Sections
add-javascript-toggle-optional-sections.description: Demonstrates how to attach JavaScript actions to PDF form fields using Aspose.Pdf so that checking a box or selecting a radio button shows or hides related sections.

create-pdf-table-of-contents-with-outlin.title: Create Table of Contents with Clickable Bookmarks
create-pdf-table-of-contents-with-outlin.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF Table of Contents by extracting heading elements, inserting a TOC page, and adding clickable outline entries (bookmarks) that navigate to each heading.

batch-apply-pdf-password-protection.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with Password Protection
batch-apply-pdf-password-protection.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt all PDF files in a folder using Aspose.Pdf, applying the same user and owner passwords and setting specific permissions.

dynamic-header-footer-pdf.title: Create PDF with Dynamic Header and Footer using JavaScript
dynamic-header-footer-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add read‑only header and footer form fields to each page and populate them with page‑specific text via an OpenAction JavaScript script.

add-auto-close-javascript-to-pdf.title: Add Auto-Close JavaScript to PDF
add-auto-close-javascript-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed JavaScript in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so the document automatically closes after a specified timeout.

generate-invoices-with-sales-graph.title: Generate Invoices with Sales Graphs from Template
generate-invoices-with-sales-graph.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF template, adding order details as text, inserting a sales chart image, and saving a separate invoice PDF for each order.

create-multi-column-text-layout.title: Create Multi-Column Text Layout with FloatingBox
create-multi-column-text-layout.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's FloatingBox and ColumnInfo to flow text across multiple columns with custom widths and spacing, then save the result as a PDF.

create-pdf-invoice-with-embedded-zugferd.title: Create PDF Invoice with Embedded ZUGFeRD XML
create-pdf-invoice-with-embedded-zugferd.description: The example shows how to generate a minimal ZUGFeRD XML document from an order, embed it into a PDF as an attached file, and convert the PDF to PDF/A‑3B for ZUGFeRD compliance.

layered-transparent-rectangles-pdf.title: Create PDF with Overlapping Transparent Rectangles
layered-transparent-rectangles-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF containing layered graphics by adding semi‑transparent rectangles that overlap, using Aspose.Pdf's Graph and drawing primitives.
